stem: How many yards are equivalent to 1,116 inches? (1 yard = 36 inches)

stem: A manager is responsible for ordering supplies for a shaved ice shop. The shop's inventory starts with 4,500 paper cups, and the manager estimates that 70 of these paper cups are used each day. Based on this estimate, in how many days will the supply of paper cups reach 1,700?
rationale: Let x represent the number of days in which the estimated supply of paper cups will reach 1,700. The equation 4,500 − 70x = 1,700 represents this situation. Subtracting 4,500 from both sides yields −70x = −2,800. Dividing both sides by −70 yields x = 40. Therefore, based on this estimate, the supply of paper cups will reach 1,700 in 40 days.

stem: Which expression is equivalent to (x² + 11)² − (x − 5)(x + 5)?

stem: The relationship between two variables, x and y, is linear. For every increase in the value of x by 1, the value of y increases by 8. When the value of x is 2, the value of y is 18. Which equation represents this relationship?
rationale: A linear relationship can be written as y = mx + b, where m is the slope. Since y increases by 8 for every increase of 1 in x, the slope m = 8, giving y = 8x + b. Substituting x = 2 and y = 18 yields 18 = 8(2) + b, or 18 = 16 + b, so b = 2. Therefore, the equation y = 8x + 2 represents this relationship.

stem: At the time that an article was first featured on the home page of a news website, there were 40 comments on the article. An exponential model estimates that at the end of each hour after the article was first featured on the home page, the number of comments on the article had increased by 190% of the number of comments on the article at the end of the previous hour. Which of the following equations best represents this model, where C is the estimated number of comments on the article t hours after the article was first featured on the home page and t ≤ 4?
rationale: The model can be represented by C = Ka^t. Since there were 40 comments when t = 0, K = 40. Since the number of comments increases by 190% each hour, the number of comments at the end of the first hour is 40 plus 190% of 40 (that is, 40 + 76 = 116), so when t = 1, C = 116. Substituting into C = 40a^t yields 116 = 40a, so a = 2.9. Therefore, the equation that best represents this model is C = 40(2.9)^t.

stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and BC = 162. Point D on side AB is connected by a line segment with point E on side AC such that line segment DE is parallel to side BC and CE/AE = 2. What is the length of line segment DE?
rationale: Since DE is parallel to BC, triangle ADE is similar to triangle ABC by the angle-angle similarity postulate, with DE corresponding to BC, and AE corresponding to AC. Since corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional, DE/BC = AE/AC. Since CE = 2·AE and AC = AE + CE, AC = AE + 2AE = 3AE. Substituting BC = 162 and AC = 3AE into DE/BC = AE/AC yields DE/162 = AE/(3AE) = 1/3. Multiplying both sides by 162 yields DE = 54.

stem: A rectangle has an area of 155 square inches. The length of the rectangle is 4 inches less than 7 times the width of the rectangle. What is the width of the rectangle, in inches?
rationale: Let x represent the width, in inches, of the rectangle. The length is 7x − 4 inches. Since area equals width times length, x(7x − 4) = 155, or 7x² − 4x − 155 = 0. Factoring yields (7x + 31)(x − 5) = 0, giving x = −31/7 or x = 5. Since the width must be positive, the width of the rectangle is 5 inches.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = a√(x + b), where a and b are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = f(x) passes through the point (−24, 0), and f(24) < 0. Which of the following must be true?

Since the graph passes through (−24, 0), substituting x = −24 and f(x) = 0 yields 0 = a√(−24 + b) = a√(b − 24). Since a ≠ 0 (as a < 0), it follows that √(b − 24) = 0, so b = 24. Since a < 0 and b = 24 (positive), a/b < 0 must be true.

stem: In the xy-plane, a circle has center C with coordinates (h, k). Points A and B lie on the circle. Point A has coordinates (h + 1, k + √102), and angle ACB is a right angle. What is the length of AB?
rationale: Since A and B lie on the circle with center C, AC and BC are both radii and are therefore congruent. Using the distance formula, the length of AC is √((h+1−h)² + (k+√102−k)²) = √(1² + (√102)²) = √(1+102) = √103. So BC is also √103. Since angle ACB is a right angle, triangle ACB is a right triangle with legs AC and BC and hypotenuse AB. By the Pythagorean theorem, AB² = (√103)² + (√103)² = 103 + 103 = 206. Taking the positive square root yields AB = √206.

In the given system of equations, r is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of r?
rationale: For a system of two linear equations to have no solution, the lines must be distinct and parallel, meaning the coefficients of x and y in one equation are proportional to the corresponding coefficients in the other equation. Rewriting the first equation in standard form yields 48x − 112y = 24. Rewriting the second equation in standard form yields a coefficient of x that is 1/4 the coefficient of x in the first equation (12/48 = 1/4). For the lines to be parallel, the coefficient of y in the second equation must also be 1/4 of the coefficient of y in the first equation: r = −112 × (1/4) = −28. Thus, if the given system has no solution, the value of r is −28.
